name: sonifiers-core
description: Zero-dependency web-based sonifiers with a standardized API

scripts.build: npm run build:esm && npm run build:cjs
scripts.build:cjs: tsc --module commonjs --outDir dist/cjs --moduleResolution node --target esnext --declaration false && node -e "require('fs').writeFileSync('dist/cjs/package.json', '{\"type\": \"commonjs\"}')"
